subject: Recap & next: buying lanes, procurement owners, and PO timing
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baxter <tom@novalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next: buying lanes, procurement owners, and PO timing

Tom — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick written recap so we have aligned next steps and owners.

Call highlights (short):
- Use case: embed search + summarization for customer support KB; target 30k monthly queries initially.
- Primary non-functional asks: <10% latency p95 target on typical queries, redaction/PII controls, and on-prem option in Q2 2029 if required.
- Decision criteria you called out: cost per 1k queries, SOC2 evidence, and procurement simplicity (PO vs card).

Open items / asks for you (can reply inline):
1) Economic buyer — confirm name and email so we can tailor commercial.
2) Procurement lead — who owns PO/invoice routing (name + finance email).
3) Security evidence — you mentioned SOC2 + data retention policy; will your security ops accept a hosted SOC2 + signed DPA?
4) Target timeline — you said finance prefers month-end PO issuance; can you confirm expected PO date window (e.g., by 11/30)?

Attached: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (short demo), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft timeline & owners).

Suggested next steps (my proposal):
- You confirm items 1–3 by EOD Wed 11/7.
- We finalize MAP and pricing tier, then route contract to Legal.
- Finance issues PO (if PO path) or we proceed with card for pilot.

If easier, loop your procurement contact on reply and I’ll send a one-page intake packet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with procurement/security if helpful.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Tom Baxter <tom@novalytics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novalytics Procurement <procurement@novalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next: buying lanes, procurement owners, and PO timing

Michael — great summary, thanks. Quick answers below and I attached the internal vendor intake so procurement can triage.

1) Economic buyer: Sarah Klein (VP Product) — sarah.klein@novalytics.com
2) Procurement lead: Maya Ortiz — procurement@novalytics.com (she's the intake owner)
3) Security: securityops@novalytics.com is the team. They need our SOC2 summary + a short DPA. I checked — they accept hosted SOC2 (Type II) plus a signed DPA for pilots.
4) Timeline: for pilots we can try to get a PO by 11/24 but finance is busy; worst case they can issue a PO by 12/08. If that's too slow we can run a short card-backed pilot first.

Attached: vendor-intake-form.pdf (complete).

Tom Baxter
Head of Integrations, Novalytics
tom@novalytics.com | (617) 555-0104

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next: buying lanes, procurement owners, and PO timing

Tom — perfect, thanks for the details and for attaching the intake file. A couple quick clarifications and a proposed MAP timeline (we can edit):

Clarifications:
- Thanks for Sarah and Maya — copying the names into the MAP. Is Sarah the final sign-off for budget or does Legal/Finance also need to explicitly approve?
- For security ops, please point me at a contact email or a person on securityops so we can share SOC2 + DPA draft.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- 11/6: Redwood sends updated MAP with roles + pricing tier (we'll attach SOC2 summary + DPA draft).
- 11/7–11/10: Novalytics Security & Procurement review intake + docs.
- 11/13: Joint sync (15–20m) to resolve remaining questions.
- 11/24: Target PO issuance (accelerate) / fallback: 12/08.

Two procurement questions for your team:
A) PO vs card for pilot — which is preferred operationally? If PO, does finance require a formal SOW or just purchase order referencing our quote?
B) Invoice billing point — Net 30 from invoice or Net 45? I want to capture this for Legal/Finance.

If Maya (procurement) wants, I can send a dedicated intake packet to procurement@novalytics.com and include a short checklist so they can route to payables.

I can update the MAP and share an editable link (Drive). See HubSpot deal for current proposal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-7831.

Thanks — will stand by for contacts.

—
Michael

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (updated link forthcoming)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Novalytics — procurement path & pricing checklist

Team — quick internal note after Tom's reply. Key points:
- Economic buyer: Sarah Klein (VP Product) — she'll own budget sign-off. Add her to the pricing email thread.
- Procurement: Maya Ortiz (procurement@novalytics.com) is intake owner; they returned the vendor intake form (attached to thread).
- Security: securityops@novalytics.com will accept hosted SOC2 + signed DPA for a pilot. We should prepare a short evidence pack: SOC2 summary, data handling one-pager, and DPA draft. Rishi: can you pull the SOC2 summary and the DPA template?
- Commercial asks: Confirm Net 30 vs Net 45 and whether finance requires a formal SOW. Lauren: can you confirm standard PO billing language we prefer for pilots?

Goal: have MAP & evidence pack ready 11/6 so Tom can circulate to their stakeholders and we keep the 11/24 PO target realistic. If procurement pushes, fallback is card-backed pilot.

I will create the HubSpot task and set reminder for 11/10.

—
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
